description: Story / map dialogue message window (speaker portrait on the left).
format: Speaker「text」 or Speaker（thought）; '@' = new line; lines 2-3 start with one full-width space
limits_en: 3 lines x 352 px with the VWF font; check with tools/textfit.py
notes: Speaker names that come from placeholders (#男愛称 / #女愛称) still show the default Japanese names.
